# Keep flag-column display booleans separate from native masked sort values

The adapter exposes unread by negating the Read bit and flagged as a boolean Marked bit. Its JavaScript comparators put unread and marked messages first using opposite bit comparisons. Native SQL uses flags & Read and ~flags & Marked; the latter yields zero or the Marked mask, not necessarily zero or one. Preserve those directions and representations together when changing the columns. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Panorama flag column representations.
